args.body: Take CATALOGUE-INBOUND-CAD-ORDER-READINESS under a valid lease. Reuse the completed catalogue text-only run. The new check is whether the operator could accept a commission under documented catalogue terms, and what the operator can say if those terms are missing. Use the welfare payment handoff only for the administrative sequence. Read back the resulting packet or the equivalent committed evidence before closure.

description: Treasury has zero verified available funds and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so eligible demand remains unknown. The catalogue’s live offer supports the existing pilot draft, and the text-only diagnostic has passed a synthetic rehearsal. The pilot still depends on an authorized operator’s send-or-decline decision. Independently, test whether an eligible inbound inquiry can be handed off for a paid CAD order under documented terms. Keep the welfare checkpoint at 17:00 UTC today and retirement at 17:00 UTC on December 4.
